articles.title: Crude prices may normalise to USD 70 by end-2027 as global oil market moves into surplus: Report
articles.content: Global crude oil prices are projected to normalize around USD 70 per barrel by the end of 2027. Rising non-OPEC+ supplies and declining Chinese oil demand are expected to lead to a market surplus. Refining margins are likely to remain elevated in the near term before gradual normalization occurs. Geopolitical tensions, particularly between the US and Iran, are likely to influence oil supply dynamics.

articles.title: Sebi proposes limiting tenure of chief executives, independent directors of stock exchanges, market infrastruction institutions
articles.content: India's Securities and Exchange Board is proposing crucial adjustments to governance norms affecting market institutions. Key suggestions include lowering the age threshold for public interest directors from 75 to 70 years, instituting a maximum of two three-year terms for directors, and restricting managing directors to an eight-year tenure. Current executives can finish their ongoing terms despite these proposed changes. SEBI is seeking public feedback on these recommendations by December 11.

articles.title: Sebi plans consultation paper to remove FPI constraints absent in other markets
articles.content: SEBI is set to release a consultation paper aimed at simplifying regulations for foreign portfolio investors. The goal is to eliminate certain compliance restrictions to enhance India's appeal to global investors. SEBI also plans to expedite the onboarding process, targeting completion in just five business days.
